newsitem.title: USA: SL to sell Auburn unit to Cooper Industries.
newsitem.headline: SL to sell Auburn unit to Cooper Industries.

text.p: SL Industries Inc on Thursday said it was selling its SL Auburn subsidiary to Cooper Industries Inc.
The company, which makes engineered products for the electrical and electromechanical markets, did not disclose terms of the deal.
SL Auburn, a manufacturer of products for the aviation and industrial markets, generated revenues of $10.7 million last year, the company said.
Cooper makes electrical and automotive products.
Cooper Industries also makes tools and hardware, which represents about 25 percent of the company's sales which were $5.3 billion in 1996.
